skill.name: flutter-fix-layout-issues
skill.description: Fixes Flutter layout errors (overflows, unbounded constraints) using Dart and Flutter MCP tools. Use when addressing "RenderFlex overflowed", "Vertical viewport was given unbounded height", or similar layout issues.
skill.summary: Diagnoses common Flutter constraint failures and applies targeted widget layout fixes.

content.value_statement: Flutter constraint errors can hide the widget that caused the failure. This skill maps common error signatures to focused layout corrections and verification steps.
actual_capabilities: Identifies common Flutter layout failures from their exception messages.
Explains how parent constraints cause unbounded height, unbounded width, and overflow errors.
Maps layout failures to Expanded, Flexible, SizedBox, or corrected parent placement.
Guides debug-mode reproduction, hot reload, and visual validation.
Provides before-and-after examples for ListView, TextField, and RenderFlex problems.
limitations: It focuses on common constraint errors and does not cover every rendering failure.
Suggested wrappers may require adjustment for the intended responsive behavior.
It requires access to the relevant widget source and runtime error output.
It does not replace testing across screen sizes, orientations, and accessibility settings.

use_cases.title: Resolve a First Layout Exception
use_cases.description: Match a console error to a standard constraint fix and verify the result with hot reload.
use_cases.target_user: Flutter developers learning the constraint model

use_cases.title: Repair Overflowing Screens
use_cases.description: Find Row or Column children that exceed available space and choose an appropriate flexible wrapper.

use_cases.title: Review Generated Widget Trees
use_cases.description: Check generated Flutter layouts for invalid parent placement and unconstrained scrollable or input widgets.

prompt_templates.title: Fix a Basic Layout Error
prompt_templates.prompt: Fix this Flutter layout error: [error message]. Review this widget: [widget source]. Explain the cause and make the smallest suitable change.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when one error message and a small widget are available.

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose a Stack Trace
prompt_templates.prompt: Find the primary constraint failure in this Flutter stack trace: [stack trace]. Ignore cascading errors, identify the responsible widget, and propose a focused fix.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when several related rendering errors appear together.

prompt_templates.title: Choose the Correct Constraint
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Flutter layout: [source]. Compare Expanded, Flexible, and explicit sizing for this context. Implement the option that preserves intended behavior.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when several technically valid wrappers have different layout effects.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a Responsive Screen
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect this Flutter screen for overflows, unbounded constraints, and invalid ParentData placement: [source]. Fix confirmed issues and validate likely narrow-screen behavior.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for a broader layout review before release.

output_examples.input: A ListView inside a Column reports an unbounded vertical viewport.
output: Primary cause: the Column gives the ListView no finite height.
Correction: constrain the ListView with Expanded when it should consume remaining space.
Validation: hot reload and confirm the list scrolls without a layout exception.

output_examples.input: A TextField inside a Row reports that InputDecorator has unbounded width.
output_examples.output: The Row does not assign a finite width to the input. Wrap the TextField with Expanded or Flexible, then verify neighboring controls.

output_examples.input: Long text in a Row produces a right-side RenderFlex overflow.
output_examples.output: Constrain the text within the remaining row width using Expanded. Confirm wrapping and inspect the result at narrow screen widths.

best_practices: Fix the first constraint violation before addressing cascading RenderBox errors.
Choose flexible or fixed constraints according to the intended responsive behavior.
Validate each correction with hot reload and several realistic viewport sizes.
anti_patterns: Do not wrap every failing widget in Expanded without checking its parent type.
Do not hide overflow indicators without correcting the underlying constraints.
Do not use fixed dimensions when content or viewport size must adapt.

faq.question: Which Flutter errors does this skill address?
faq.answer: It addresses common unbounded height, unbounded width, RenderFlex overflow, ParentData, and cascading RenderBox layout errors.

faq.question: Does it modify Flutter source files?
faq.answer: It can guide or apply focused widget-tree changes when source access and editing tools are available.

faq.question: When should I use Expanded instead of Flexible?
faq.answer: Use Expanded to fill remaining space. Use Flexible when the child may occupy less than its allocated share.

faq.question: Can it fix ListView inside Column?
faq.answer: Yes. It can constrain the ListView with Expanded or a suitable explicit height, depending on the intended interface.

faq.question: Does it test every device size?
faq.answer: No. You must validate the corrected layout across relevant widths, orientations, text scales, and platforms.

faq.question: Does it require Flutter MCP tools?
faq.answer: The workflow can use available Dart and Flutter tools, but the diagnostic guidance remains useful without MCP integration.
